description: Search Shodan for hosts matching <query> using Shodan search syntax (e.g. "apache country:US", "port:22 org:\"Google\""). Returns matching hosts with IP, port, org, hostnames, product, and location. Example: shodan_host_search({ query: "apache country:US", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Shodan API key (account.shodan.io; paid membership required)

query.description: Shodan search query. Supports filters like country:, org:, port:, product:, os:, e.g. "apache country:US"

name: shodan_host_search
title: Shodan Host Search
